titre: A pawn steps in and hits two. Which takes? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Take with which pawn? 👇 Only 1.exd4! wins: 1.exd4 cxd4 2.cxd4 and the pawn runs home. 1.cxd4 c4 is just a draw (Stockfish 16, composed position). One new puzzle every day.
